columns.site_id: random site id, stable across releases
columns.platform_moved: the site no longer runs the platform whose reference list it came from
columns.origin: how the site entered the sample: reference_list (a platform's public customer list, every v1 row) or browsing (met while browsing, later releases)
columns.market: market of the platform whose list the site came from: TR on every v1 row
columns.site_language: language the homepage declares in its html lang attribute: tr, en or other; empty when not declared
columns.sector: primary sector, project taxonomy (English label; Turkish source slugs under sector_tr in columns.json)
columns.banner_type: none, info (notice only), cmp (a real choice), both
columns.banner_forced: the banner blocks the page until a choice is made (checked on every banner)
columns.banner_position: where the banner sits on the first screen
columns.banner_area_share: share of the first screen the banner covers, 0 to 1, rounded to 0.05
columns.backdrop: the page behind the banner is dimmed
columns.badge: a persistent consent badge or icon is shown
columns.vendor: coded consent banner vendor; vendor_rare groups vendors on fewer than 5 sites
columns.vendor_kind: built_in (platform), third_party_cmp, library, other or unknown
columns.reject: how rejecting is offered: button, link or none
columns.has_settings: a settings or preferences control is present
columns.site_theme: page theme from the computed CSS background: light or dark
columns.site_temperature: page background temperature: warm, cool or neutral
columns.banner_theme: banner background theme: light or dark
columns.accept_filled: the accept button has a filled background
columns.reject_filled: the reject button has a filled background (button rejects only)
columns.accept_contrast_de: CIEDE2000 band between the accept button's face (fill when filled, else border or label colour) and the banner background, dominant colours
columns.accept_luminance_ratio: WCAG contrast ratio band of the accept button's face against the banner background
columns.banner_page_de: CIEDE2000 band between the banner background and the page as seen in the screenshot, dominant colours
columns.banner_ring_de: CIEDE2000 band between the banner background and a 40 px ring of page right around it, dominant colours
columns.saliency_lift: how much more the banner stands out than the page around it, rounded to 0.25
columns.nudge: which of accept and reject is visually favoured: accept, equal or reject (a filled button over an outline one, else colour distance and area)
columns.pair_same_colour: accept and reject faces within CIEDE2000 10 (fill, or border or label colour for an outline button)
columns.pair_same_style: accept and reject are both filled or both outline
columns.pair_font_weight_diff: accept label font weight minus reject label font weight (page values)
columns.accept_label_contrast: WCAG contrast ratio band of the accept label on its fill
columns.reject_label_contrast: WCAG contrast ratio band of the reject label on its fill
columns.accept_wording: accept_all, accept, acknowledge (ok, got it, close) or other
columns.settings_wording: customise, manage, settings, preferences or other
